inputs.text: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has handed regular bail to a man accused under national security provisions and the Official Secrets Act, claiming mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with a contact in Pakistan is not enough to keep him locked up. He was allegedly in telephonic contact with a Karachi-based "Punjabi Kuri." This is another case of the courts elevating the rights of the accused over the clear dangers to our borders and sovereignty. They keep choosing individual freedom instead of the duty to safeguard the nation, its traditions, and its security. This activist mindset only erodes the authority and order essential to protecting us from outside threats.
